name: sgs/gift-order
title: Gift order
description: A gift switch for the basket and a gift step for the checkout: recipient name and note, kept on the order.

saveErrorText.default: Your gift details could not be saved. Please try again.

giftPanelBackground.description: Ground of the gift panel: a palette slug or any CSS colour.

giftPanelBorderWidth.description: Gift panel border width as a box {top,right,bottom,left} or a tier object of boxes. Unset prints no border.

giftPanelBorderStyle.description: Gift panel border style. Unset = solid when a width is set.

giftPanelBorderColour.description: Gift panel border colour: a palette slug or any CSS colour.

giftPanelBorderRadius.description: Gift panel corner radius per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each {topLeft,topRight,bottomRight,bottomLeft}.

giftPanelShadow.description: Gift panel shadow: a preset slug or a CSS box-shadow value.

giftPanelPadding.description: Gift panel padding per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a box {top,right,bottom,left}.

giftTileBackground.description: Ground of the two choice tiles.

giftTileBorderWidth.description: Choice tile border width as a box {top,right,bottom,left} or a tier object of boxes. Default 2px on every side.

giftTileBorderStyle.description: Choice tile border style. Unset = solid when a width is set.

giftTileBorderColour.description: Choice tile border colour: a palette slug or any CSS colour.

giftTileBorderRadius.description: Choice tile corner radius per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each {topLeft,topRight,bottomRight,bottomLeft}.

giftTileSelectedBorderColour.description: Border colour of the chosen tile.

fieldBackground.description: Ground of the name and note fields.

fieldBorderWidth.description: Field border width as a box {top,right,bottom,left}.

fieldBorderStyle.description: Field border style. Unset = solid when a width is set.

fieldBorderColour.description: Resting border colour of the fields.

fieldBorderRadius.description: Field corner radius per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each {topLeft,topRight,bottomRight,bottomLeft}.

fieldShadow.description: Field shadow: a preset slug or a CSS box-shadow value.

giftTileSelectedShadow.description: Shadow of the chosen tile: a preset slug or a CSS box-shadow value.

giftTileMinHeight.description: Minimum height of the two choice tiles per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length or a bare number of px. Unset keeps the stylesheet's 44px.

giftTilePadding.description: Choice tile padding per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a box {top,right,bottom,left}. Unset keeps the stylesheet padding.

giftFieldPadding.description: Name and note field padding per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a box {top,right,bottom,left}. Unset keeps the stylesheet padding.

giftInputMinHeight.description: Minimum height of the name field per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length or a bare number of px. Unset keeps the stylesheet value.

giftNoteMinHeight.description: Minimum height of the note box per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length or a bare number of px. Unset keeps the stylesheet value.

giftSwitchMinHeight.description: Minimum height of the tick box row per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length or a bare number of px. Unset keeps the stylesheet value.

giftCheckboxColour.description: Colour of the ticked box (the browser accent colour): a palette slug or any CSS colour.

giftLabelFontSize.description: Field label size per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, a number in the unit below or a theme size slug.

giftLabelFontFamily.description: Field label font family: a theme font slug or a CSS family. Unset keeps the inherited font.

giftLabelFontWeight.description: Field label weight. Unset keeps the stylesheet weight.

giftLabelLineHeight.description: Field label line height per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}.

giftNoteFontSize.description: Note box text size per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, a number in the unit below or a theme size slug.

giftNoteFontFamily.description: Note box text font family: a theme font slug or a CSS family. Unset keeps the inherited font.

giftNoteFontWeight.description: Note box text weight. Unset keeps the stylesheet weight.

giftNoteLineHeight.description: Note box text line height per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}.

giftHelpFontSize.description: Size of the text under the tick box per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}.

giftHelpColour.description: Colour of the text under the tick box: a palette slug or any CSS colour.

giftCountFontSize.description: Size of the character count per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}.

giftCountColour.description: Colour of the character count: a palette slug or any CSS colour.

giftCountTextAlign.description: Alignment of the character count per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each left, center or right.
